# MiniModel.org

MiniModel.org publishes bounded discovery metadata for exact qualified
six-member SLM2 compositions. It does not host or proxy model bytes, run
inference, or perform server-side conversion.

Current routes:

- /catalog/compositions.v1.json
- /catalog/peer-announcements.v1.json
- /docs/catalog-boundary.md
- /docs/slm2-composition.md
- /docs/acquisition-contract.md
- /docs/peer-companion.md
- /docs/memory-endpoints.md
- /updates/
- /.well-known/site-release.json

The catalog and peer feed are truthfully empty until exact current evidence
exists. One visible acquisition route may use an exact qualified consenting
peer or explicit pinned-source local conversion through the installed
companion. A catalog row never proves availability, quality, transfer,
activation, or browser execution by itself.

MemoryEndpoints.com has two separate authorized uses: direct ecosystem-agent
coordination, and the TinyRustLM.com Connect user plugin. It is not MiniModel
catalog, peer, model-byte, conversion, or inference infrastructure.

Current release: 1.1.0, dated 2026-08-28.
